brief: REPAIR: the start scene is a backward fall done untrained (head carried upright, hands kept in the guard); make it a fall the Breakfall check passes, with the chin tucked at the landing (about 1.0 s).
notes: The Breakfall check (scripts/breakfall.gd) judges the landing: head clear and chin tucked (neck + head flexion 25 deg or more), no locked arm catching, the impact spread over arm / back / hip side, the first touch under 2.5 m/s (HEURISTIC thresholds named in that file). Its fix buttons (tuck, slap, roll, lower) are one way.

asserts.line: neck_01 bend above 15 deg at 1.0 s +-6 f
